name: Queue Time Managment
query:
SELECT 
    DATE(q.time) AS "Date:Date:100", 
    q.patient AS "Patient:Data:80",
    q.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:250",
    q.practitioner AS "Doctor:Data:250",
    SUBSTRING(CAST(q.time AS CHAR), 1, 8) AS "Que Time",
    IFNULL(SUBSTRING(CAST(pe.encounter_time AS CHAR), 1, 8), 'yet') AS "Encounter Time",
    IFNULL(SUBSTRING(CAST(sc.time AS CHAR), 1, 8), 'yet') AS "Sample Collection Time",
    IFNULL(SUBSTRING(CAST(lr.time AS CHAR), 1, 8), 'yet') AS "Lab Result Time",

    IFNULL(
        IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, q.time, pe.encounter_time) > 60,
           CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, q.time, pe.encounter_time) / 60), ' hour(s)'),
           CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, q.time, pe.encounter_time), ' minute(s)')),
        'yet'
    ) AS "Time Diff Queue to Encounter",

    IFNULL(
        IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pe.encounter_time, sc.time) > 60,
           CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pe.encounter_time, sc.time) / 60), ' hour(s)'),
           CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pe.encounter_time, sc.time), ' minute(s)')),
        'yet'
    ) AS "Time Diff Encounter to Collection",

    IFNULL(
        IF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sc.time, lr.time) > 60,
           CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sc.time, lr.time) / 60), ' hour(s)'),
           CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, sc.time, lr.time), ' minute(s)')),
        'yet'
    ) AS "Time Diff Collection to Result"

FROM tabQue q

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT patient, encounter_time
    FROM `tabPatient Encounter`
    WHERE encounter_date = %(date)s
) pe ON q.patient = pe.patient

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT patient, time
    FROM `tabSample Collection`
    WHERE date = %(date)s
) sc ON q.patient = sc.patient

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT patient, time
    FROM `tabLab Result`
    WHERE date = %(date)s
) lr ON q.patient = lr.patient

WHERE q.date = %(date)s

GROUP BY q.date, q.patient

ORDER BY q.time DESC;
